entities.summary: The Pagode du bois de Vincennes is the seat of the Institut international bouddhique founded by Jean Sainteny who was the manager of the institute. It is located in a former building of the International Colonial Exposition of 1931, designed by the architect Louis-Hippolyte Boileau. On this 8 000 m2 site on the edge of the lac Daumesnil are located two buildings of remarkable architecture. The largest, the former pavilion of Cameroon, was restored in 1977 and transformed in a pagoda and a place of worship.
